themes.consensus_view: Every bank that took a position on AI infrastructure spending is positive, expects the spending cycle to last and grow, and nobody in the corpus argues against it.

facts_agreed.claim: UBS and Goldman Sachs Asset Management both expect AI spending to keep growing and call the investment cycle durable, with UBS forecasting USD 1.2 trillion of AI capital spending in 2027.
evidence_quotes: We forecast AI industry capital spending of USD 1.2 trillion in 2027
We believe the AI investment cycle will remain durable
We have strong conviction in the long-term potential gains offered by AI.

facts_agreed.claim: Demand for AI computing is broadening from chips to inference and agentic workloads as AI moves from pilots into production.
evidence_quotes: The AI trade outperformed as the compute-demand narrative broadened to inference and agentic workloads.
AI has moved from pilots to production.

themes.consensus_view: The banks that took a view all back higher policy rates, pointing to inflation running above targets, and Scotiabank says the RBA is widely expected to resume hiking, with no bank arguing against.

facts_agreed.claim: Banks that took a view see inflation pressure and firm growth as justifying higher policy rates.
evidence_quotes: Inflation is exceeding the target set by three of the four central banks
The upward shift in both long-term yields and policy rates has structural as well as cyclical elements
The RBA is widely expected to resume its tightening cycle on Tuesday

themes.consensus_view: Banks across several desks mention the US-Iran talks and the Strait of Hormuz as a live backdrop for oil and rates, but none has staked a directional view on how the talks end.

evidence_quotes: Today, the United States faces the opposite challenge. The population is aging, labor force growth is slowing

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple desks reference US federal debt, deficits and fiscal sustainability as a subject of concern, without staking a directional view.
evidence_quotes: US fiscal deficit and 30-year bond term premium

themes.consensus_view: Six research desks treat possible Fed and Bank of England rate hikes this autumn as a live market input, but none of them stakes out a directional view in the material provided.
